$schema_doc: Each YouTube community QUIZ is one object. The schedule-tweets skill (yt-post-quiz) picks up the first quiz with status='pending' and posts it to YouTube's community section as a Quiz post (a poll where exactly ONE option is marked correct, plus an optional explanation shown after the viewer answers). Status flow: 'pending' -> 'posting' -> 'posted' -> 'captured' (results snapshotted) -> 'failed'. YouTube quiz constraints mirror polls: question_text up to ~3000 chars, 2-4 options each up to 65 chars, EXACTLY ONE correct answer given by correct_option_index (0-based). explanation is OPTIONAL (shown after answering; keep it short, NO em dashes). YouTube quizzes do NOT auto-close; they stay open until the post is deleted. total_votes/results are populated when results are captured.

quizzes.topic: Kaspa GHOSTDAG consensus: what makes it the fastest proof of work coin
quizzes.question_text:
Kaspa is the fastest pure proof of work coin in crypto.

What breakthrough consensus protocol lets it hit blazing block rates without giving up any proof of work security?
quizzes.hook: What breakthrough makes Kaspa the fastest proof of work coin?
options: GHOSTDAG (a blockDAG, not a single chain)
quizzes.explanation: GHOSTDAG orders parallel blocks in a DAG instead of orphaning them, so Kaspa keeps proof of work security at high speed.

quizzes.topic: Kaspa fair launch: no premine, no presale, open mining from block one
quizzes.question_text:
Kaspa is famous for how it came into the world: no insiders got a head start.

How was KAS first distributed when the network went live in November 2021?
quizzes.hook: How was Kaspa first distributed at launch?
options: Fair launch, open mining from block one
quizzes.explanation: No premine, no presale, no insider allocation. Mining was open to everyone from the very first block.

quizzes.question_text: What is the name of the next generation, parameterless consensus proposed for Kaspa?
quizzes.hook: What is Kaspa's proposed next-gen consensus?
quizzes.explanation: DAGKnight is a proposed responsive, parameterless successor to GHOSTDAG.

quizzes.question_text: Who published the Bitcoin whitepaper under a pseudonym in 2008?
quizzes.hook: Who created Bitcoin?
quizzes.explanation: Bitcoin was introduced by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto in 2008.

quizzes.question_text: In most proof of work chains, blocks found at the same time are wasted. What does Kaspa do with them?
quizzes.hook: What does Kaspa do with parallel blocks?
options: Keeps and orders them in the DAG
quizzes.explanation: Instead of orphaning parallel blocks, Kaspa keeps and orders them for more throughput.

quizzes.question_text: Kaspa is one of the most talked about proof of work coins. What is its ticker symbol?
quizzes.hook: What is Kaspa's ticker symbol?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa trades under the ticker KAS.

quizzes.question_text: How does the Bitcoin whitepaper describe the system in its title?
quizzes.hook: What does Bitcoin's whitepaper title call it?
quizzes.explanation: The 2008 paper is titled Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System.

quizzes.question_text: What does NFT stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does NFT stand for?
quizzes.explanation: NFT stands for Non-Fungible Token, a unique on chain item.

quizzes.question_text: On Ethereum, what is the fee you pay to run a transaction called?
quizzes.hook: What is an Ethereum transaction fee called?
quizzes.explanation: Ethereum transaction fees are called gas, paid to process your transaction.

quizzes.question_text: Bitcoin is a single chain of blocks. What structure does Kaspa use instead?
quizzes.hook: What block structure does Kaspa use?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa uses a blockDAG, where blocks can reference multiple parents, not just one.

quizzes.question_text: Which company dominates the market for chips used to train AI models?
quizzes.hook: Who makes most AI training chips?
quizzes.explanation: Nvidia's GPUs power most large scale AI training today.

quizzes.question_text: How often does the Bitcoin block reward roughly halve?
quizzes.hook: How often does Bitcoin halve?
quizzes.explanation: The reward halves every 210,000 blocks, about every four years.

quizzes.question_text: The saying not your keys, not your coins refers to controlling what?
quizzes.hook: What does not your keys, not your coins mean?
quizzes.explanation: If you do not hold your private keys, you do not truly control your coins.

quizzes.question_text: In what year did the Kaspa mainnet go live?
quizzes.hook: When did Kaspa launch?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa's mainnet launched in November 2021.

quizzes.question_text: What consensus mechanism does Bitcoin use?
quizzes.hook: How does Bitcoin reach consensus?
quizzes.explanation: Bitcoin uses proof of work, where miners compete with computing power.

quizzes.question_text: What was the name of Ethereum's 2022 switch from mining to Proof of Stake?
quizzes.hook: What was Ethereum's move to Proof of Stake called?
quizzes.explanation: In 2022 The Merge moved Ethereum from proof of work to proof of stake.

quizzes.question_text: Which hashing algorithm secures Bitcoin mining?
quizzes.hook: What hash algorithm does Bitcoin use?
quizzes.explanation: Bitcoin mining is based on the SHA-256 hashing algorithm.

quizzes.question_text: In AI, what does the abbreviation LLM stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does LLM stand for?
quizzes.explanation: LLM stands for Large Language Model, the tech behind modern AI chatbots.

quizzes.question_text: Kaspa's node software was rewritten for performance from Go into which language?
quizzes.hook: Kaspa's node was rewritten into which language?
quizzes.explanation: The rusty-kaspa rewrite moved the node from Go to Rust for speed.

quizzes.question_text: What does fine-tuning an AI model mean?
quizzes.hook: What is fine-tuning?
options: Adapting a pretrained model on new data
quizzes.explanation: Fine-tuning adapts an already trained model to a narrower task or dataset.

quizzes.question_text: Which 2017 paper introduced the transformer architecture behind modern AI?
quizzes.hook: Which paper introduced the transformer?
quizzes.explanation: The 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need introduced the transformer.

quizzes.question_text: Which of these is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar?
quizzes.hook: Which of these is a US dollar stablecoin?
quizzes.explanation: USDC is a stablecoin designed to hold a value of one US dollar.

quizzes.question_text: In what year was Bitcoin's genesis block mined?
quizzes.hook: When was Bitcoin's first block mined?
quizzes.explanation: The genesis block was mined in January 2009.

quizzes.question_text: In GHOSTDAG, well connected honest blocks are grouped into which set?
quizzes.hook: What are well connected blocks called in GHOSTDAG?
quizzes.explanation: GHOSTDAG labels well connected blocks blue and poorly connected ones red.

quizzes.question_text: At its 2021 mainnet launch, how fast did Kaspa produce blocks?
quizzes.hook: How fast were Kaspa's early blocks?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa launched at one block per second, already far faster than most chains.

quizzes.question_text: How does Kaspa secure its network?
quizzes.hook: How is Kaspa secured?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa is pure proof of work, secured by miners, with no staking or validators.

quizzes.question_text: Which company created ChatGPT?
quizzes.hook: Who created ChatGPT?
quizzes.explanation: ChatGPT was created by OpenAI.

quizzes.question_text: Kaspa's chief scientist co-authored an early protocol cited in Ethereum's yellow paper. Which one?
quizzes.hook: Which protocol did Kaspa's scientist co-author?
quizzes.explanation: Sompolinsky co-authored GHOST, cited in Ethereum's yellow paper, and later GHOSTDAG.

quizzes.question_text: Bitcoin has the satoshi. What is the smallest unit of a KAS called?
quizzes.hook: What is Kaspa's smallest unit?
quizzes.explanation: The smallest unit of Kaspa is the sompi, one hundred millionth of a KAS.

quizzes.question_text: What is the maximum number of bitcoin that will ever exist?
quizzes.hook: What is Bitcoin's max supply?
quizzes.explanation: Bitcoin is capped at 21 million coins, a hard limit in the code.

quizzes.question_text: Roughly how many KAS will ever exist?
quizzes.hook: What is Kaspa's max supply?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa's supply caps at about 28.7 billion KAS.

quizzes.question_text: How much of Kaspa's supply was premined for insiders?
quizzes.hook: How much of Kaspa was premined?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa had no premine, no presale, and no insider allocation.

quizzes.question_text: On Ethereum, what standard defines a basic fungible token?
quizzes.hook: What standard defines Ethereum tokens?
quizzes.explanation: ERC-20 is the standard for fungible tokens on Ethereum.

quizzes.question_text: In Proof of Stake, what mainly decides who validates blocks?
quizzes.hook: What decides validators in Proof of Stake?
quizzes.explanation: In Proof of Stake, validators are chosen largely by how many coins they stake.

quizzes.question_text: The 2025 Crescendo upgrade raised Kaspa's throughput to how many blocks per second?
quizzes.hook: What did Crescendo do for Kaspa?
quizzes.explanation: The Crescendo hardfork took Kaspa to 10 blocks per second.

quizzes.question_text: In crypto, what does DeFi stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does DeFi stand for?
quizzes.explanation: DeFi means Decentralized Finance, financial apps that run without middlemen.

quizzes.question_text: What is the smallest unit of a bitcoin called?
quizzes.hook: What is Bitcoin's smallest unit?
quizzes.explanation: The smallest unit is a satoshi, one hundred millionth of a bitcoin.

quizzes.question_text: A 51 percent attack means one party controls a majority of what?
quizzes.hook: What does a 51 percent attack control?
options: The network's mining or staking power
quizzes.explanation: A 51 percent attack is when one party controls most of the mining or staking power.

quizzes.question_text: GHOSTDAG is best described as a generalization of what?
quizzes.hook: What does GHOSTDAG generalize?
quizzes.explanation: GHOSTDAG generalizes Nakamoto's longest chain rule from a chain to a DAG.

quizzes.question_text: In the model name GPT, what do the letters stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does GPT stand for?
quizzes.explanation: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer.

quizzes.question_text: About how long does Bitcoin target between blocks?
quizzes.hook: What is Bitcoin's block time?
quizzes.explanation: Bitcoin aims for a new block roughly every 10 minutes.

quizzes.question_text: In crypto governance, what does DAO stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does DAO stand for?
quizzes.explanation: A DAO is a Decentralized Autonomous Organization governed by its token holders.

quizzes.question_text: What is Bitcoin's best known layer 2 network for fast, cheap payments?
quizzes.hook: What is Bitcoin's main layer 2?
quizzes.explanation: The Lightning Network settles fast, low cost Bitcoin payments off chain.

quizzes.question_text: How does Kaspa's coin emission change over time?
quizzes.hook: How does Kaspa's emission work?
options: Only a vote can change it
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa's emission steps down smoothly each month in a deflationary curve.

quizzes.question_text: Like Bitcoin, Kaspa tracks funds using which accounting model?
quizzes.hook: What accounting model does Kaspa use?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa uses the UTXO model, the same coins in, coins out design as Bitcoin.

quizzes.question_text: Which company released the open weight Llama models?
quizzes.hook: Who makes the Llama models?
quizzes.explanation: Meta develops the open weight Llama family of language models.

quizzes.question_text: What is the name of Kaspa's proof of work mining algorithm?
quizzes.hook: What is Kaspa's mining algorithm?
quizzes.explanation: Kaspa is mined with kHeavyHash, its own proof of work algorithm.

quizzes.question_text: Who is the chief scientist most associated with Kaspa's design?
quizzes.hook: Who is Kaspa's chief scientist?
quizzes.explanation: Yonatan Sompolinsky, a blockDAG researcher, is the mind behind Kaspa's consensus.

quizzes.question_text: In blockDAG, what does DAG stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does DAG stand for?
quizzes.explanation: DAG means Directed Acyclic Graph, the structure Kaspa arranges blocks in.

quizzes.topic: Robinhood Chain: what it actually is
quizzes.question_text: What kind of network is Robinhood Chain?
quizzes.hook: What kind of network is Robinhood Chain?
options: An Ethereum layer 2 built on Arbitrum
quizzes.explanation: It is an Ethereum layer 2 built with Arbitrum technology, so it settles to Ethereum.

quizzes.question_text: Robinhood Chain produces a new block roughly every...
quizzes.hook: How fast are Robinhood Chain blocks?
quizzes.explanation: 100 millisecond blocks, which is what makes it feel instant next to Ethereum mainnet.

quizzes.question_text: Robinhood Chain opened its public mainnet in which month?
quizzes.hook: When did Robinhood Chain actually go live?
quizzes.explanation: Mainnet went live on July 1, 2026. February 2026 was the testnet, which did 4 million transactions in week one.

quizzes.topic: What stock tokens do not give you
quizzes.question_text: Robinhood stock tokens track the price of a US stock 24/7. What do they NOT give you?
quizzes.hook: What do Robinhood stock tokens NOT give you?
options: The ability to self custody them
Ownership and voting rights in the company
quizzes.explanation: They track the price only. No shareholder ownership and no voting rights in the underlying company.

quizzes.question_text: Robinhood Chain is a layer 2. Which chain does it settle to for security?
quizzes.hook: Which chain does Robinhood Chain settle to?
quizzes.explanation: It settles to Ethereum. That is what being an Ethereum layer 2 means.

quizzes.question_text: Robinhood built its chain for tokenized stocks and real world assets. What actually took over the activity on it?
quizzes.hook: Robinhood built it for stocks. What took it over?
quizzes.explanation: Memecoins. The chain was built for RWAs and the memes ate it, which is the whole joke of Robinhood Chain.

quizzes.question_text: The Robinhood Chain memecoin Artificial Inu is paired with a tokenized version of which stock?
quizzes.hook: Artificial Inu is paired with which tokenized stock?
quizzes.explanation: NVIDIA. A dog memecoin paired to tokenized NVDA is peak Robinhood Chain.

quizzes.question_text: Which two crypto protocols shipped integrated with Robinhood Chain from day one?
quizzes.hook: Which protocols shipped on Robinhood Chain day one?
quizzes.explanation: Uniswap for swaps and Chainlink for price data were both live at launch.

quizzes.question_text: Has Robinhood itself issued an official Robinhood Chain token or airdrop?
quizzes.hook: Is there an official Robinhood Chain airdrop?
options: No, there is no official Robinhood Chain token
quizzes.explanation: There is no official Robinhood Chain token and no airdrop from Robinhood. Anything claiming otherwise is a scam.

quizzes.question_text: Some Robinhood Chain memecoins do something no meme has done before. What is it?
quizzes.hook: What can a Robinhood Chain meme do that no meme could before?
quizzes.explanation: Hold the coin and tokenized stock tokens get airdropped to your wallet. Memes handing out equity exposure.

quizzes.question_text: EIP-1559 changed how Ethereum fees work in 2021. What does it do with the base fee?
quizzes.hook: What does Ethereum do with the base fee?
quizzes.explanation: The base fee is burned, permanently removing that ETH from supply. Only the tip goes to the validator.

quizzes.question_text: The Merge in September 2022 switched Ethereum from proof of work to what?
quizzes.hook: What did The Merge switch Ethereum to?
quizzes.explanation: Proof of stake. Energy use dropped by roughly 99.9 percent overnight.

quizzes.question_text: How much ETH does a solo validator need to stake at minimum?
quizzes.hook: How much ETH do you need to run a validator?
quizzes.explanation: 32 ETH is still the minimum. Pectra raised the MAXIMUM effective balance to 2048, not the entry price.

quizzes.question_text: Ethereum blobs were added to make one thing much cheaper. What?
quizzes.hook: What are Ethereum blobs actually for?
options: Cheap temporary data space for rollups
quizzes.explanation: Blobs are cheap short lived data space for layer 2 rollups. They expire after about 18 days by design.

quizzes.question_text: Which Ethereum upgrade introduced blobs and collapsed layer 2 fees?
quizzes.hook: Which upgrade introduced blobs?
quizzes.explanation: Dencun, in March 2024. Layer 2 fees fell by orders of magnitude almost immediately.

quizzes.question_text: The Fusaka upgrade went live in December 2025. What was its headline feature?
quizzes.hook: What was the headline feature of Fusaka?
quizzes.explanation: PeerDAS, which let nodes sample blob data instead of downloading all of it. Roughly 8x more throughput for rollups.

quizzes.question_text: On Ethereum, what does gas actually measure?
quizzes.hook: What does gas actually measure on Ethereum?
options: The computational work a transaction uses
quizzes.explanation: Gas measures computational work. The gas price is what you pay per unit of that work.

quizzes.question_text: What is the smallest unit of ether called?
quizzes.hook: What is the smallest unit of ether?
quizzes.explanation: A wei. One ETH is a quintillion wei, and a gwei is a billion wei, which is why gas is quoted in gwei.

quizzes.question_text: Which Ethereum token standard is used for ordinary fungible tokens?
quizzes.hook: Which standard is used for fungible tokens?
quizzes.explanation: ERC-20 is the fungible token standard. ERC-721 is the NFT one.

quizzes.question_text: After Dencun and Fusaka, a typical transaction on a major Ethereum layer 2 costs roughly...
quizzes.hook: What does a layer 2 transaction cost now?
quizzes.explanation: Fees on the major layer 2s sit well under a cent now. Blob space is what made that possible.

quizzes.question_text: Kaspa's first vProg just ran with real execution on testnet. What does vProgs stand for?
quizzes.hook: What does vProgs stand for?
quizzes.explanation: Verifiable programs: apps built on the Kaspa L1, secured by proof of work.

quizzes.source_transcript: video-creation/livestream-repurpose/transcripts/beer and kaspa LOW BPS VERTICAL/beer and kaspa LOW BPS VERTICAL_plain.txt
quizzes.question_text: Tokens launched on Kaspa follow which token standard?
quizzes.hook: Which token standard do Kaspa tokens use?
quizzes.explanation: KRC-20 is the Kaspa token standard. ERC-20 is Ethereum, BEP-20 is BNB Chain, SPL is Solana.

quizzes.question_text: Alt season watchers track OTHERS dominance on TradingView. What does OTHERS measure?
quizzes.hook: What does OTHERS dominance measure?
options: Total crypto market cap excluding the top 10
Bitcoin's share of the total market
The ETH to BTC price ratio
quizzes.explanation: OTHERS is the crypto market excluding the top 10 coins. When its dominance breaks out, the smaller alts are leading.
